scope: Retrospective supported-condition review approved by user after failed results; not a pre-inference exclusion or a new holdout.
reason: Rear close chin-up repeatedly hides hands/forearms behind head and torso at raised positions; sufficient arm motion is not visible throughout the cycle.
supportedCaptureRule: Shoulders, elbows and wrists should remain visible through the movement. Front/rear alone is insufficient when narrow-grip self-occlusion hides the arms.

phoneGuidance.title: SHOW YOUR ARMS
phoneGuidance.instruction: Move camera so both arms are visible
phoneGuidance.pullUpFallback: Either currently usable arm clears the warning.
phoneGuidance.activation: Running set, one athlete, valid image, consecutive source frames with hidden or low-confidence arm chains.
phoneGuidance.priority: Replaces grip setup card and grip label; orange CHECK VIEW header.
